spec.description: Namespaces reserving CPU or memory they never use, ranked by how much they could give back. Waste comes from the finops:* recording rules so this dashboard and any other read the same definition.

spec.title: Reclaimable CPU
spec.description: Cores reserved by flagged namespaces and never used, even at the 7-day peak.

spec.expr:
sum(sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  finops:namespace_cpu_wasted_cores:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (cluster, namespace) (
  finops:namespace_cpu_requests:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > $min_cores
  and
  finops:namespace_cpu_utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < $max_util
)
))

spec.title: Reclaimable memory
spec.description: Bytes reserved by flagged namespaces and never touched, even at the 7-day peak.

spec.expr:
sum(sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  finops:namespace_memory_wasted_bytes:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (cluster, namespace) (
  finops:namespace_memory_requests:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > ($min_gib * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
  and
  finops:namespace_memory_utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < $max_util
)
))

spec.title: Flagged namespaces
spec.description: Namespaces meeting both thresholds on CPU or memory.

spec.expr:
count(
  ((
  finops:namespace_cpu_requests:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > $min_cores
  and
  finops:namespace_cpu_utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < $max_util
))
  or
  ((
  finops:namespace_memory_requests:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > ($min_gib * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
  and
  finops:namespace_memory_utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < $max_util
))
)

  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  finops:namespace_cpu_wasted_cores:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (cluster, namespace) (
  finops:namespace_cpu_requests:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > $min_cores
  and
  finops:namespace_cpu_utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < $max_util
)
))
/
sum(sum by (cluster) (
  clamp_max(
    topk(1,
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
      or
        kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
    ) by (cluster, namespace)
    , 1)
  * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
  finops:namespace_cpu_requests:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
))

spec.title: Worst offenders by project — CPU
spec.description: Reclaimable cores rolled up per project, biggest first.

spec.expr:
topk($max_shown,
  sum by (label_product, label_project) (
    clamp_max(
      topk(1,
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", label_product!=""} * 2
        or
          kube_namespace_labels{label_product=~"$product", label_project=~"$project", label_environment_kind=~"$kind", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}
      ) by (cluster, namespace)
      , 1)
    * on (cluster, namespace) group_right(label_environment_kind, label_project, label_product, label_client)
    finops:namespace_cpu_wasted_cores:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (cluster, namespace) (
    finops:namespace_cpu_requests:current{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > $min_cores
    and
    finops:namespace_cpu_utilization_ratio:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} < $max_util
  )
  )
)

    finops:namespace_cpu_wasted_cores:max_7d{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (cluster, namespace) (

    and

  )
  )
)

spec.title: FinOps - Compute (CPU & RAM) - Optimization - Shrink candidates

spec.name: max_util
spec.label: Flag under utilisation
spec.description: A namespace is flagged when its 7-day peak usage stays under this fraction of its requests.

spec.name: min_cores
spec.label: Ignore under (cores)
spec.description: Namespaces reserving less than this are too small to be worth chasing.

spec.name: min_gib
spec.label: Ignore under (GiB)
spec.description: Memory equivalent of the cores floor.

spec.name: max_shown
spec.label: Max rows shown
spec.description: How many rows each table and the chart draw.
